sources.title: Smooth Start
markers: | summary = '''Smooth Start''' is a passive feature that allows the wearer to move quickly at the start of combat.

summary: At the start of combat, gain Momentum for 3 turns.

fields.Smooth Start: Movement increases by 5 ft per remaining turn of Momentum. If the wearer enters mid-round the effect waits for the next round. Slowed can clear it early.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
